intent: A mountain-devotee's basalt gown of ash-sashed bodice and flaring magma-seamed columns, crowned with obsidian shards; from the high camera a narrow black top over a wide red-veined bell with a tall pale-rimmed crown.
requests: A way to make the magma seams glow: armour has no emissive colour, so the cracks are painted only.
A standing collar that clears the blocky head: any collar rising above the shoulders within the neck's width clips the head.
